say:0:1222710001:0.text: Magister... it's the golden peacock! You caught the golden peacock!
say:0:1222710001:0.source_cn: 主人……是黄金孔雀！你钓到了黄金孔雀！
say:0:1222710001:0.male: Magister... it's the golden peacock! You caught the golden peacock!
say:0:1222710001:0.female: Magister... it's the golden peacock! You caught the golden peacock!

say:1:1222710002:0.text: Of course, Merlin did it! He reeled in the king of fish with ease!
say:1:1222710002:0.source_cn: 不愧是梅林！这么轻松就钓到了传说中的鱼王！
say:1:1222710002:0.male: Of course, Merlin did it! He reeled in the king of fish with ease!
say:1:1222710002:0.female: Of course, Merlin did it! She reeled in the king of fish with ease!

say:2:1222710003:0.text: Oh right, we should bring it to that scholar, Jaxon, and let him have a look.
say:2:1222710003:0.source_cn: 对了，我们把它带去给那位名叫约克逊的学者看看吧。
